bounds.description:
Physical cell-edge bounds in meters. For structured FDM grids, `min`
is the grid edge origin and `max` is `origin + shape * spacing`.
Cell centers are offset by `spacing / 2` on non-zero axes.

cut_kind.description: How the cut position was specified: `"normalized"` or `"world"`.

cut_world.description: Resolved cut in world coordinates (m), if domain bounds are known.

etag.description: Stable fingerprint covering all resolved parameters (ETag for the meta resource).

sampling_method.description:
Sampling path used to construct this slice.

Examples: `fdm_nearest`, `fem_fallback_fdm_nearest`.

slice_revision.description: Stable fingerprint covering all resolved parameters.

x_pixels.description: Pixel width of the slice grid.

y_pixels.description: Pixel height of the slice grid.

component.description:
Component to return.

Accepted values: `full` (default), `magnitude`, `x`, `y`, `z`, `c0`, `c1`, …, `cN-1`.

- `full` → full interleaved vector (nComp unchanged)
- `magnitude` → per-point L2 norm (nComp=1)
- `x`/`y`/`z`/`cN` → single component by index (nComp=1)

max_samples.description:
Optional hard cap for vector samples returned by the binary payload.

Scoped FEM queries are sampled by scope node index. Unscoped queries
return a contiguous center window for lightweight diagnostics.

scope_kind.description:
Optional FEM scope for large-domain samples.

Accepted values: `full`, `object`, `part`, `airbox`, `selection`.
`object` and `part` require `scope_id`; `airbox` may omit it and resolves
to the first mesh part with role `air`; `selection` resolves from the
current workspace selection.

capabilities.description: Canonical UI gating source for the current session. Platform and meshing capabilities have narrower ownership.

display.description: Current renderer/view selection. The writable display resource is `visualization/display`.

domain.description: Thin domain summary for adapter selection. Heavy topology is owned by `data/domain/topology` and meshing mesh resources.

energies.description: Thin latest energy summary for status surfaces. Energy samples/history are owned by `simulation/solver/energies/*`.

metrics.description: Lightweight runtime metrics for status surfaces. Detailed logs/diagnostics live under `diagnostics/*`.

resources.description: Revision pointers used to invalidate resource hooks. Heavy resources must be fetched from their owning endpoint.

oneOf.description: Thin run summary for header/status surfaces. Full run metadata is owned by `simulation/runs/*`.

session.description: Thin current-session summary. Full session persistence state is owned by persistence resources.

solver.description: Thin solver summary for polling cadence and top-bar state. Detailed solver state is owned by `simulation/solver/status`.

active_build.description: Current active build descriptor and progress metadata.

effective_airbox_target.description: Resolved target for the current build. Summary-level copies are transitional dashboard projections.

effective_per_object_targets.description: Resolved per-object targets for the current build. Summary-level copies are transitional dashboard projections.

last_build_summary.description: Current/last build summary for build panels. Latest-success endpoint owns stable successful build references.

oneOf.description: Typed shared-domain build report extracted from the latest build summary when present.

last_build_summary.description: Detailed latest build summary for diagnostics and inspectors.

mesh_pipeline_status.description: Detailed build pipeline state for diagnostics and build panels.

mesh_quality_summary.description: Detailed mesh-build quality diagnostics. Dashboard quality summaries are transitional projections only.

mesh_statistics.description: Full mesh statistics report for realized solver mesh diagnostics.

mesh_adaptivity_state.description: Meshing adaptivity capability/state only. UI-wide gating remains owned by `status.capabilities`.

mesh_capabilities.description: Meshing policy/build feature matrix only. UI-wide gating remains owned by `status.capabilities`.

effective_airbox_target.description: Transitional target projection retained for current frontend adapters.

effective_per_object_targets.description: Transitional target projection retained for current frontend adapters.

last_success.description: Last successful build artifact/reference summary. It must not become a copy of the active build resource.

oneOf.description: Transitional diagnostics projection retained for current frontend adapters. New consumers should use build/quality/report resources.

universe_config.description: Solver-domain universe mesh policy. This endpoint owns mesh semantics, not build diagnostics.

mesh_parts.description: Scoped mesh parts for object/airbox/selection fetches. Heavy topology remains in binary topology endpoints.

effective_airbox_target.description: Transitional dashboard target summary. Build-specific target resolution is owned by `meshing/builds/current`.

effective_per_object_targets.description: Transitional dashboard target summary. Build-specific target resolution is owned by `meshing/builds/current`.

mesh_quality_summary.description: Transitional dashboard quality summary. Detailed quality diagnostics are owned by `meshing/meshes/*/quality`.

mesh_summary.description: Lightweight dashboard mesh counts/shape summary. Detailed topology lives in mesh topology resources.

RestoreClass.description: What level of session restoration is possible.

SaveProfile.description: Which elements to include when saving a session.

ui_state.description: Optional UI workspace snapshot provided by frontend.

SessionInspection.description: Result of inspecting a `.fms` file before committing to open it.

origin.description:
Physical grid edge origin in meters. Cell centers are
`origin + (i + 0.5) * spacing` on non-zero axes.

visible.description: Compatibility target visibility override. Prefer `display.visible` for new clients.

active_quantity_id.description: Compatibility projection for current display clients. Prefer `quantity.active_quantity_id`.

auto_contrast.description: Compatibility projection for current display clients. Prefer `quantity.auto_contrast`.

camera.description: Session-wide viewport camera. All connected clients should converge to this view.

clip.description: Compatibility projection of the legacy single clip plane.

colormap.description: Compatibility projection for current display clients. Prefer `quantity.colormap`.

contrast_max.description: Compatibility projection for current display clients. Prefer `quantity.contrast_max`.

contrast_min.description: Compatibility projection for current display clients. Prefer `quantity.contrast_min`.

diagnostics.description: Backend normalization warnings and degraded-state reasons for display controls.

field_component.description: Compatibility projection for current display clients. Prefer `quantity.field_component`.

layers.description: Independent renderer layers. This is the canonical View ribbon state model.

max_points.description: Compatibility projection for current display clients. Prefer `sampling.max_points`.

overrides.description: Object/part overrides. Endpoint projections must patch this state, not create a second store.

quantity.description: Canonical quantity/color state. New clients should read this instead of the flat compatibility fields.

revision.description: Monotonic revision of all visualization state.

sampling.description: Sampling and memory budget policy for heavy renderer data.

schema_version.description: Schema semver for consumers to detect payload shape changes.

targets.description: Complete effective target registry for the current scene and mesh.

trim.description: Canonical 3-D trim controls for topology-aware viewports.

vector_density.description: Compatibility projection for current display clients. Prefer `layers.vectors.density`.

vector_glyphs.description: Compatibility projection for current display clients. Prefer `layers.vectors.visible`.

vector_style.description: Vector glyph style independent from vector visibility and sampling.

view_mode.description: Compatibility projection for current display clients.

x_chosen_size.description: Compatibility projection for current display clients. Prefer `fdm.x_chosen_size`.

y_chosen_size.description: Compatibility projection for current display clients. Prefer `fdm.y_chosen_size`.
